description: DC1, DC2 and DC3 switched from location-based to market-based reporting this year (REGO-backed supply contract). Last year was location-based and has not been restated, so the year-on-year fall is not like for like (about 320 tCO2e). Location-based figure must be disclosed alongside.

DC6 was removed from the reporting boundary when operational control passed to the 3PL operator. Last year comparatives still include DC6 (about 911 tCO2e) and the base year was not recalculated, so the reduction is overstated. Boundary change policy not applied.

REGO certificates cover only part of DC1 to DC3 consumption but the market-based factor was applied to all of it. Certificate volumes are not reconciled to kWh. An auditor would not accept the full market-based factor without certificate evidence.
UK grid factor update from 0.207 to 0.193 kg CO2e per kWh was applied correctly to all location-based sites, but the effect is not shown separately in the year-on-year reconciliation.
Electricity use at HQ1 and HK1 was estimated for three months because half-hourly meter data was unavailable. Immaterial but not disclosed.
Prior-year review: no documented policy for restating emissions after a method or boundary change.
LED retrofit savings at stores are claimed but not yet verified; installation records are incomplete.
Supplier-reported data is mostly estimated and not validated against purchase volumes.
